description: This file defines an API class 'ModulesAPI' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Api'. It handles CRUD interactions (primarily listing and updating) related to module configurations for the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving module statuses and updating them. The class integrates with services like ModuleService, handles API documentation annotations, and manages module enable/disable states.

classes.name: ModulesAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for listing and updating module configurations in OrangeHRM, handling responses and integrating with underlying services.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the ModuleService instance used to manage module data.

methods.name: getConfigurableModulesArray
methods.description: Returns an array indicating which modules are configurable, with their current enabled/disabled status, including OAuth mobile client status.
